findings.reason: the section must add UV_CACHE_DIR (or UV_NO_CACHE) to the redirect list or drop the "writes nothing outside IMASDB" claim, since the done-when is otherwise unachievable on the server.
findings.text: the done-when "The install writes nothing outside IMASDB and its staging directory" redirects UV_TOOL_DIR, UV_TOOL_BIN_DIR and UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR but not uv's download/build cache, which both `uv python install` and `uv tool install` write to (~/.cache/uv by default); the cache is owned by the UV_CACHE_DIR / UV_NO_CACHE knobs and the repo's own notes name UV_CACHE_DIR as the uv cache control (~/.agents/AGENTS.md:1434), so the stated measure is false as written

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the facility layout stays behind one owner: the installer and launcher supply only the IMASDB folder, and every path (maps/current, ids) is derived by §8's resolve_settings (packages/imas-alambic/src/imas_alambic/settings.py:_maps, _ids_root), so a caller supplies no path.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — the changed done-when claims the install writes nothing outside IMASDB, but redirects three UV_* variables while leaving the uv cache, whose owner is UV_CACHE_DIR/UV_NO_CACHE, as an unredirected second writer.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §5 is a provisioning section that adds to none of the four families (it uses imas-alambic config, already counted under §8) and names its retirement of §4's ~/imas-alambic/.venv and env.sh.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the changed unit names the machinery it extends and replaces (§8 settings.py owns the layout, §4 env.sh and its venv are replaced, §1's bundle is relayed), and a census of /home/ITER/mcintos/Code/imas-ambix finds no prior shared-install machinery to rebuild: no install/ directory, no UV_TOOL_*/uv tool use and no bundle-relay script under packages/ or scripts/, so the installer and launcher are genuinely new.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the IMASDB/bin/imas-alambic launcher is a shell layer the engine's own entry point cannot be: clearing PYTHONPATH and setting IMAS_ALAMBIC_HOME must happen before the interpreter starts, so `uv tool install`'s generated console script is not machinery that can be extended in place.
